up: Retrieve distinct compounds tested against human histone deacetylase 6. Return the compound name and canonical SMILES. Filter the target by organism 'Homo sapiens' and target name 'histone deacetylase 6'. Ensure results only include compounds with a valid canonical SMILES. Do not apply any row limits.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    md.pref_name,
    cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE
    td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
    AND LOWER(td.pref_name) LIKE '%histone deacetylase 6%'
    AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
